entries.title: Psalms 149:2
segments:
In him that made him; God made Israel, not only as all men are his creatures, but also as "a people near unto him." 
 
"The Israel of God" have for their King one to whom all power is given in heaven and in earth.  Under his government they are always safe, and have always abundant reason for rejoicing.

entries.title: Psalms 149:3
segments: In the dance--with the timbrel and harp; with sacred songs, accompanied, after the manner of the Hebrews, with musical instruments and dancing.

entries.title: Psalms 149:4
segments: Beautify; adorn.  Salvation is here compared to a beauteous robe.

The meek, who are conscious of their own weakness and unworthiness, and quietly commit their cause to God, always find that salvation of which the proud and self-sufficient, who rely on themselves, are sure to fail.

entries.title: Psalms 149:5
segments: Upon their beds; a place for pious meditation.

entries.title: Psalms 149:6
segments: And a two-edged sword in their hand; when God's church had, by his appointment, a national form, conflicts sword in hand with surrounding enemies were a part of the duty of his people.  So when the Jews were rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem under Nehemiah, "the builders, every one had his sword girded by his side, and so builded."

entries.title: Psalms 149:9
segments:
Written; appointed by God. 
 
  This honor; the honor of accomplishing the will of God upon his enemies. 
 
The greatest honor which a man can receive, is to be employed by God as an instrument of advancing his cause in the world.  "This honor have all his saints," each in his proper station, and according to the measure of the gifts bestowed upon him by God.
